acs.name: American Community Survey
acs.about: IPUMS USA, ACS 5-year sample 2020–2024 (about 5% of US households). Income covers the 12 months before each interview, put into 2024 dollars with the Census Bureau's ADJINC.
acs.strengths: Large enough for states, metro areas, local areas and narrow slices. Housing costs.
acs.se: Standard errors from the 80 ACS household replicate weights (successive difference replication).
acs.topcodes: Income items above a state's cutoff are replaced by the state mean of those values; households with a member at that value are flagged as topcoded.

cps.name: Current Population Survey (ASEC)
cps.about: IPUMS CPS, Annual Social and Economic Supplement 2021–2025 (income years 2020–2024), in 2024 dollars with the CPI-U. The Census Bureau's official source for national income.
cps.strengths: About 50 income questions (the ACS has 8), so income sources such as pensions, interest and dividends are measured better. Calendar-year income. Multiple jobs.
cps.se: Standard errors from the 160 CPS household replicate weights (Fay's balanced repeated replication).
cps.topcodes: The CPS swaps the highest values between similar records instead of capping them, so no household is flagged.
